items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: I got a little boy to call Shelly to play with us that was a brother-in-law, one of the trumpet players.

ctx.x: Was there just one club there they called it the alley or was there really a little alley there that put several clubs around the alley?

No, but this was that one club. Just one club. This one club. So I didn't hardly go down there but now they played down there. So I put me up a little band, distilled it at Sturias. So Rene was playing, Ed Hand in the band and Ed was so she, I think George played with them yet. So I put up a band and I had Johnny Sincere was starting with us.
